purpose: Can one ordinary course entry with the full verified tool inventory and no strategy flag use the extra budget to independently compare a second genuinely different finalist?
trigger: With no explicitly requested review, no active LLM controller or external rule, and enough fits for exploring and corroborating alternatives on independent folds, the default local controller may lock one extra contender. This depends on observable budget and number of folds on any task. The existing small-budget path remains available.
nominate: On accuracy tasks consider affordable singles and equal pairs besides the first challenger. A pair must beat both its constituents. A proposal must repair rows missed by both the first challenger and the anchor (compared separately), and fall within one row-paired standard error of the primary leader or exceed it. Rank by score plus one paired standard error, then the additional physical cost. Reserve identical measurements on all unused folds and enough full refits before accepting a second alternative. Prospective default decisions and final promotion still use only training feedback. Never supply the winning method, pairs, a task identity or a previous run's decisions.
experiment: One fresh run with every installed eligible tool, the raw training archive, the feature-only validation input and a budget. The parent process passes only fit and time limits, then the ordinary solve command. Pretrained weights and unsupervised per-text vectors are permitted. A bounded exact-order per-process cache may reuse a frozen encoder forward pass; all supervised fits including refits are counted.
score: Seal the final exported output, independently rerun without the feature cache, and compare with the frozen prior score or perform one designated validation scoring if predictions differ. Report all autonomous arms. No course test or H2 or paid API.
